title: Apocalypse Now Legendary Survival Overhaul
description: A simple data pack that adds The Legend of Survival compatibility to Apocalypse Now, making every APN item properly hydrate or dehydrate you.
body:
This is a simple data pack that adds **The Legend of Survival (Thirst Version)** compatibility to the **Apocalypse Now** mod, making your wasteland survival experience more immersive and unified. From now on, every canned food and mutated meat from the APN mod will properly hydrate or dehydrate you—no more awkward disconnection between food and thirst systems.

This is an **early version**, with thirst values already adjusted for most APN items. I plan to keep updating based on feedback, gradually covering more items and fine-tuning the balance for a smoother experience.

Please note that this data pack is a **prerequisite component** for my **yet-to-be-released modpack**. If you encounter any issues while using it separately, feel free to share your feedback—it will help me improve!
